description: This file defines an interface HonoPasswordEncoder which provides methods for encoding passwords and verifying matches against stored hashed credentials within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: HonoPasswordEncoder
classes.description: An interface for encoding and matching passwords against credentials managed by Hono's credential service.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Computes a hash for a raw password, returning a JsonObject containing hash details.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a raw password matches the stored hashed credential secret.
